name: Lazotep Plating
oracle_text:
Amass Zombies 1. (Put a +1/+1 counter on an Army you control. It's also a Zombie. If you don't control an Army, create a 0/0 black Zombie Army creature token first.)
You and permanents you control gain hexproof until end of turn. (You and they can't be the targets of spells or abilities your opponents control.)
blocked_sentences: You and permanents you control gain hexproof until end of turn. (You and they can't be the targets of spells or abilities your opponents control.)

needs.what: a one-shot op giving a player hexproof for a duration ("you gain hexproof until end of turn"), usable from a spell's spell_effects, e.g. {"op": "grant_player_hexproof", "player": "you", "duration": "this_turn"}
needs.why_existing_wont_do: player_hexproof exists only as a static effect, which lives on a permanent and cannot be carried by an instant; grant_keyword reaches permanents but not players, so it covers only the 'permanents you control' half; grant_protection takes a player but protection is not hexproof; an emblem with a player_hexproof static would last forever, not until end of turn. The Amass Zombies 1 sentence alone is expressible (amass op, zombie_army_0_0_b token).
